title: /smart-compliance loads the hero section, usage chips, and three tabs without error
preconditions: A project is selected in the Redux store
expectedResult: Page renders ComplianceHeroSection (Start AI Assessment / Add Framework buttons), and the Active Frameworks / Framework Recommendations / Questionnaire History tabs, with no console errors.

title: 'Start AI Assessment' opens the questionnaire modal and loads the active question catalog
preconditions: At least one active SCQuestion exists
expectedResult: Modal opens on the assessment-metadata step with a progress bar showing 'Step 1 of N'; no error state or infinite skeleton.

title: Submitting a minimal single-question assessment returns a recommendation and redirects to the response page
preconditions: Questionnaire catalog has at least one active question
steps: Fill assessment name, answer the single question, click 'Submit Assessment'
Wait for the AI loading screen to complete
expectedResult: Browser redirects to /smart-compliance/response/{id}; the page shows at least the AI overall analysis text and one supported-or-empty framework grid without a JS error.

title: Response detail page renders all core sections for a freshly created response
preconditions: A response was just created by SMCM-SMK-003
steps: Open /smart-compliance/response/{id} directly (or via redirect from submission)
expectedResult: Current Authority Frameworks banner, Framework Recommendations grid, and Questionnaire Results sections all render without throwing; loading skeletons resolve to real content.

title: 'Add Framework' opens the catalog modal with Added/Available/Coming Soon tabs populated
preconditions: Compliance framework catalog has at least one entry
steps: Click 'Add Framework' on the hero section
expectedResult: Modal opens showing the search bar and three tabs (Added / Available / Coming Soon) with correct counts; no error state.
